correctness.rationale: The disjoint ordered decomposition T_l=T_(l-2) union (2^(l-1)+T_(l-1)) is established from token language; its unique bridge has length h_l. Labeled bridge recurrence yields F_(l-j+1), and summing all shell contributions gives the claimed exact histogram including the h_2=h_3 collision. Dyadic boundary gap parity is exact. Pointwise limiting weights sum to one, ensuring a proper limit measure; the mean diverges because 2/phi>1. Independent direct enumeration N=1..18 is consistent; it is not relied upon for infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The previously known support and complete indexed gap sequence from A060142/A219609 are explicitly acknowledged and excluded from novelty. The new result is an all-dyadic exact Fibonacci multiplicity theorem and limiting infinite-mean distribution, neither given in the inspected full OEIS records, early automaton survey, or nearby self-generation literature. Search coverage is bounded and unindexed equivalent derivations remain possible.

value.rationale: For a classical sparse automatic sequence with known arbitrarily long zero runs, an exact frequency law for every return gap at all substitution scales gives structural information not evident from its enumerated gap sequence. The Fibonacci bridge count and explicit geometric masses produce a nontrivial heavy-tail infinite-mean phenomenon and a complete class-frequency classification. It is not an arbitrary cutoff extension or textbook renaming.
